source_scope: Frozen native002 source; current live Node003/factory edits are not qualified by this audit

official_findings.bug: WAL-reset checkpoint/writer race can corrupt a database by incorrectly preserving nBackfill across a WAL reset, causing later checkpoints to omit committed frames

official_backports.notes: official checkin context names the writer/checkpointer wraparound race; cherry pick omits testing infrastructure

official_findings.necessary_exposure: WAL mode; multiple connections to the same database in separate threads/processes; simultaneous writer reset and checkpointer start with the documented complete-checkpoint/reset/subsequent-commit sequence
official_findings.full_sync: synchronous=FULL does not alter the documented logical WAL-index race; official scope is not restricted to NORMAL
official_findings.frequency: officially rare and unusual; no project-specific probability inferred; official page records a non-test-hook reproducer as of 2026-08-24
official_findings.fix_diff_custody: No patch diff was acquired: the two ?diff=1 bodies are explicitly retained browser-verification responses. Checkin metadata and official release/WAL documentation were acquired; local exact vulnerable source was independently read.

source_reachability.observed: one owned writable db precedes owner File in drop order; owner.lock exclusive held during normal db lifetime; public service uses Mutex<Node>; separate public reader is READ_ONLY. Default WAL auto-checkpoint remains.
source_reachability.limit: A read-only observer alone is not proof of the concurrent writable/checkpointer trigger. Locked sqlite3WalCheckpoint returns READONLY for a readonly Wal. No exhaustive all-openers concurrency qualification performed.

source_reachability.observed: canonical same-cache writer-lock-v4 serializes supported writers under the original 5-second budget; each write performs configure and TRUNCATE before Immediate transaction; both writer and readonly connections disable checkpoint-on-close; writers disable auto-checkpoint and retain FULL.
source_reachability.limit: Only supported stable namespace clients participate. Arbitrary SQLite/filesystem clients are explicitly outside its contract. This is not a patched SQLite dependency or evidence for all other stores.

source_reachability.surface: new safe NativeIoLease factory and bounded VFS
source_reachability.observed: Clone lease can open multiple writable connections to the same root. The mutex covers individual ledger/VFS callbacks, not complete commit/checkpoint/reset sequences. PASSIVE and automatic checkpoints are not excluded by the authorizer.
source_reachability.limit: No malicious/reliably exploitable schedule, actual corruption, race reproducer, or production original-service regression was executed or established.

source_reachability.observed: one arena exclusive owner accompanies one WAL+FULL connection. Drop explicitly unlocks arena before Connection field destruction.
source_reachability.limit: No actual reset-race reachability proved. Locked sqlite3WalClose holds a main-db EXCLUSIVE lock before its close-time checkpoint, so early arena unlock alone does not prove concurrent writes can interleave with that checkpoint.

source_reachability.observed: separate WAL+FULL Connection factories without a same-file writer-owner fence in these openers; multiple instances can be requested by library callers.
source_reachability.limit: These sources explicitly do not install a Node backend. No claim that original production consensus activates them.

risk_judgment.meaning: Do not claim safe general concurrent-WAL durability or complete release dependency safety with the unchanged backend. Existing single-writer/serialized cache mitigations are scoped source observations, not a dependency fix. Preserve the current NO_GO; this audit does not revoke or certify any bounded finite interface control.

next_under_PN1: Choose an officially fixed SQLite lineage/backport through normal root/ROG dependency review; do not downgrade to 3.44.6 merely because that backport is listed.

Requalify exact amalgamation/source/build flags/ABI witness and update exact source pins together; the current c012/source-layout witness and Cell cache 3_046_000/padding bound deliberately reject silent substitutions.

Preserve original FULL, locks, quotas, SQL/assertions and 2s/30s limits. Re-run meaningful same-file multi-connection writer/checkpoint/close/integrity/cold-read controls on the fixed backend and its exact source; no test-count-only closure.

An alternative mitigation would need to enforce complete same-file writer/checkpointer serialization across every supported connection/auto-checkpoint/close path; a per-callback Arc ledger is insufficient. No such new mechanism is implemented or proposed as already complete here.
